title: Terraform pipeline guardian for Private EKS control plane provisioning
creator: Asha Raman
description: Build a reusable Terraform module and CI pipeline ("guardian") that performs idempotent, observable provisioning of Redwood Private EKS control planes inside customer VPCs. The module must provide transactional-like apply semantics (safe rollback guidance), integrated preflight validation, and live health gating so upgrades and new clusters do not leave control planes in partially-provisioned states. This ticket scopes the module design, CI pipeline hooks, health-check integrations, and a first implementation for bootstrapping 1-2 internal staging clusters for validation.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes a clear variable surface and documented outputs for control plane endpoint, kubeconfig bootstrap token, and IAM roles
CI pipeline runs preflight validations (VPC reachability, subnet tagging, KMS key access) and blocks applies on failures
Apply operation supports a dry-run guard (plan review) and an automated safe-apply mode that cancels when non-convergent resources are detected
Health probe service verifies API availability, certificate validity, and controller readiness post-provisioning and returns a pass/fail status to the pipeline
Documentation and runbook published with rollback and recovery steps; internal staging clusters provisioned using the module
design_notes: Module will be opinionated: focused on managed EKS control plane topology we use for Private (private endpoint + restricted SGs). Avoid adding support for every edge case in first pass.

Idempotency approach: rely on Terraform state + explicit preflight drift checks (AWS resource tags, IAM trust policy diffs). Provide helper script 'tf-guard' to interpret plan diffs and detect risky changes (control plane replacement, KMS key rebinds).

Locking/State: S3 state backend + DynamoDB lock table; recommend ephemeral, short-lived state in CI with encrypted remote backend for customer runs. Provide docs for air-gapped customers to use on-prem state storage replacement.

Upgrade choreography: implement 'windowed-upgrades' pattern that sequences control plane changes with verifiable health checks between steps. Avoid blue/green for control plane in first pass (too risky), but support canary batch for node groups in subsequent tickets.

Health checks: lightweight Lambda or container that 1) performs API server readiness probes, 2) lists kube-system pods and controller-manager status, 3) validates KMS decryption against an encrypted test secret, 4) verifies audit log sink writable. Returns JSON summary but pipeline interprets as pass/fail.
implementation_plan: Week 1: scaffold Terraform module with core resources (eks_cluster, iam roles, kms alias, security groups, route table associations). Add variables and outputs with examples.
Week 2: build preflight validations as separate step in GitHub Actions; implement tf-guard plan analyzer and unit tests.
Week 3: implement health probe container and deployable job; wire to pipeline to run post-apply checks and report status.
Week 4: iterate on failure modes, add runbook content, provision two internal staging clusters for end-to-end testing, and run upgrade drill.
Follow-up: integrate with provisioning operator for long-term reconciler support (future ticket).
testing_plan: Unit tests for tf-guard plan analyzer: simulate Terraform plan outputs with replacement and destructive changes.
Integration: pipeline deploy to staging VPCs (staging-1, staging-2) with full post-apply health checks.
Failure injection: simulate partial resource creation by denying IAM permissions in a canary to validate pipeline abort and rollback guidance.
Upgrade drill: perform minor and patch-level changes to control plane configuration and validate windowed-upgrade choreography.
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal infra team only, run two manual provisioning flows and collect telemetry (time-to-ready, failed resources, number of re-applies).
Beta: make module available to Solutions Eng for customer pilots behind a feature flag; collect security review notes.
GA: publish to terraform registry internal namespace, update onboarding docs, and include in Private deployment quickstart.
Emergency rollback: documented reversible steps using terraform state rollback and cloud provider console guided actions.
